name: Fire Scar Shrine
summary: At Fire Scar Shrine, fel corruption scars the forest southwest of Astranaar. Once a night elf place of worship, the shrine now draws demons to its altar stones.

sections.title: A Blight in the Forest
sections.body: Fire Scar Shrine lies southwest of Astranaar and west of the Ruins of Stardust. Demonic corruption has seized the shrine, fed by servants of the Cult of the Dark Strand and the Shadow Council. Fel magic has scorched the earth around it, and demons gather openly among the trees, defying the forest's defenders.

sections.title: Shadows of the Dark Strand
sections.body: Agents of the Cult of the Dark Strand and the Shadow Council brought corruption to Fire Scar Shrine. The orc warlock Ilkrud Magthrull acted under Athrikus Narassin's orders. Summoned fiends now patrol the altar stones unchecked. A tear in the veil sometimes draws greater horrors, including the towering doomguard Akkrilus.

faq.q: Where is Fire Scar Shrine located?
faq.answer: Fire Scar Shrine lies in southwestern Ashenvale, southwest of Astranaar, south of the Shrine of Aessina, and west of the Ruins of Stardust.

faq.q: Why are there demons at Fire Scar Shrine?
faq.answer: Agents of the Shadow Council and the Cult of the Dark Strand corrupted Fire Scar Shrine, with the orc warlock Ilkrud Magthrull among them. Their rituals summoned demons and left fel taint on the sacred ground.
Akkrilus is a doomguard that sometimes appears around Fire Scar Shrine, drawn by the demonic energies gathered around its corrupted stones.

faq.q: What connection does this place have to the Cult of the Dark Strand?
aliases: cult of the dark strand fire scar
faq.answer: Ilkrud Magthrull, the orc warlock who operated at Fire Scar Shrine, served Athrikus Narassin, leader of the Cult of the Dark Strand. They used the shrine as a foothold for demonic summoning and their ambitions in Ashenvale.

angles.text: As a night elf, the desecration of Fire Scar Shrine so near Astranaar calls for swift retribution against the demons sullying the forest.
As a warlock, you can read the Shadow Council's mark in the fel scars and wild demonic summons at Fire Scar Shrine, signs of its infiltrations across Kalimdor.
